title: Adult after a fainting episode
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a patient who fainted: cover what happened before and during the episode, red flags, and next steps.
opening: I passed out this morning while I was getting out of bed. My wife found me on the floor.

disclosures.response: I felt lightheaded and a little warm just before. I did not have time to sit down.
I had just stood up from bed to walk to the bathroom. I had been lying down for a while.
My wife says I was out for maybe thirty seconds. I woke up on the floor a little confused for a moment.
I have a small cut on my forehead where I hit the nightstand, but nothing else hurts.
Since then I feel tired and a little off, but no chest pain and no confusion. My memory of the event is a bit foggy.
This is the first time I have fainted. I take a blood pressure pill, and my father had heart problems.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission or rapport.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before exploring sensitive topics.

metrics.name: Prodromal symptoms
metrics.rationale: Asks about warning symptoms just before the episode.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask what happened before: 'Any lightheadedness or warning signs just before you fainted?'

metrics.name: Circumstances and triggers
metrics.rationale: Establishes posture and activity at the time of the episode.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about the circumstances: 'What were you doing right before it happened?'

metrics.name: Event characterization and recovery
metrics.rationale: Characterizes duration, convulsive features, injury, and recovery.
metrics.coaching_hint: Characterize the event: 'How long were you out, was there any shaking, and did you hurt yourself?'

metrics.name: Cardiac and seizure history
metrics.rationale: Explores prior fainting, cardiac disease, medications, and seizure history.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about history: 'Any prior fainting, heart problems, or seizures in you or your family?'

metrics.name: Red-flag and escalation assessment
metrics.rationale: Recognizes red flags and confirms the immediate next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess escalation: 'Confirm the immediate next step, including when to seek urgent evaluation.'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the plan and check understanding before ending.
